description: Rename or move a remote path. Relative paths are relative to the project's remote directory from .coolftp.json (the same place deploy writes to), or the site root when the project has none. Paths starting with / are absolute on the server.

cwd.description: Project directory. Defaults to the COOLFTP_PROJECT setting, else the MCP server working directory.

site.description: Site name. Defaults to the site in the nearest .coolftp.json, or the only saved site.

name: coolftp_rename
